scripts.build: pnpm --filter @termrelay/contracts build && pnpm --filter @termrelay/server build && pnpm --filter @termrelay/web build
scripts.check: pnpm contracts:check && pnpm -r --if-present typecheck && pnpm linux:test && pnpm mac:test
scripts.linux:contracts: pnpm --filter @termrelay/linux build && pnpm --filter @termrelay/server build && bash -o pipefail -c 'node apps/linux/dist/tests/fixtures/export-events.js | node scripts/validate-linux-events.cjs' && node scripts/linux-remote-start.cjs
